import pandas as pd
import os

# Ensure the outputs directory exists
os.makedirs('outputs', exist_ok=True)

# Read the input matrix
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Separate city/geo columns from indicator columns
# Assuming city_id, city_name, year are the non-indicator columns based on task description
geo_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in geo_cols]

# Calculate missingness for each indicator
missing_counts = df[indicator_cols].isna().sum()
total_counts = df[indicator_cols].count()
missing_rates = missing_counts / total_counts

# Create the missingness report
# Columns: indicator, missing_count, missing_rate, kept
report_data = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_cols,
    'missing_count': missing_counts.values,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates.values,
    'kept': (missing_rates <= 0.30).astype(int)
})

# Save the missingness report
report_path = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
report_data.to_csv(report_path, index=False)

# Filter indicators to keep only those with missing_rate <= 0.30
kept_indicators = indicator_cols[report_data['kept'] == 1]

# Create the selected matrix
# Keep city_id, city_name, year and only the kept indicator columns
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]

# Save the selected matrix
selected_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'
selected_df.to_csv(selected_path, index=False)
</solution_file>
